name: hypertweet-v2
description: AI-powered contextual replies for social media platforms

scripts.build: bun run lint:check && bun run typecheck && bun run build.js --target=all
scripts.watch: bun run lint:check && bun run typecheck && bun run build.js --target=all --watch
scripts.build-sidebar: bun run lint:check && bun run typecheck && bun run build.js --target=sidebar
scripts.watch-sidebar: bun run lint:check && bun run typecheck && bun run build.js --target=sidebar --watch
scripts.build-all: bun run lint:check && bun run typecheck && bun run build.js --target=all
scripts.watch-all: bun run lint:check && bun run typecheck && bun run build.js --target=all --watch
scripts.dev: bun run clean && bun run watch
scripts.prod: bun run clean && bun run build
